channel.title: wuld.ink — changelog
channel.description: Changes to wuld.ink — for posterity and transparency.

item.title: The Void Engine lexicon grew to 334 prompts across 19 categories -- Apophatica, Luminous-Void, and Void / Dissolution deepened, the Figure sets broadened, and the Chaos reroll now takes a scoped multi-select so you can aim the randomness instead of only shielding it.

(Sections: /void-engine/)
